comparison.objective: Send a tote along a roller conveyor to a distant station without slamming the end stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply a controlled initial push and regulate tote speed and direction using conveyor dynamics.
comparison.success_condition: The tote must reach and settle at the far station while remaining on the conveyor and staying below the prohibited end-stop impact threshold.
comparison.reason: Momentum regulation for conveyor transport differs from deliberately generating a localized fracture impulse while limiting lateral load and recovering debris.
